name: P1_top50
hypothesis: Holding 50 instead of 30 names per cohort diversifies stock-specific risk without diluting the signal much (vs the selected alpha's base; only n changes).

name: P2_top100
hypothesis: Holding 100 names per cohort trades more of the signal's edge for diversification; tests whether the edge is concentrated in the very top ranks (vs base; only n changes).

name: P3_inverse_vol
hypothesis: Weighting the same 30 names by inverse 63-day volatility lowers portfolio risk without giving up return (vs base; only the sizing rule changes).
